text:
Alex Lee: Heads-up — proposal: shift one weekly triage slot to 6:30pm PT (evening) as a 3-week pilot so APAC folks get overlap. Short agenda tweak: 10m backlog scrub, 10m bug deep-dive, 5m owner handoffs, 5m quick blockers. Thoughts?
Maria Gonzalez: +1 for a pilot, we get better coverage. Quick q: will this be an extra slot or replace an existing one?
Alex Lee: Extra for the pilot; keep mornings the same. Calendar changes only if pilot looks good.
Devon Park: I can cover week 1 and 3. Prefer we keep a morning backup in case the evening slot doesn't catch everything.
Samir Patel: Suggest rotating evening coverage across oncall engineers, 2-week rotation. Also propose adding a "regression" filter in the bug queue to catch recent rollouts.
Lina Chen: Can we try 6:30pm instead of 7pm? 7pm cuts into dinner for some folks here. 6:30 keeps it reasonable.
triage-bot: NOTE: current triage cadence is Mon/Wed/Fri 09:00 PT. Automations will need calendar + invite updates if cadence changes.
Alex Lee: Good call, Lina — update to 6:30pm PT. Pilot: 3 weeks starting next Tuesday. Samir — can you draft a simple rotation table people can opt into?
Samir Patel: Yep, will post a rota by EOD. Also proposing simple labels: urgent, degrad, regression, infra to speed prioritization.
Maria Gonzalez: Agenda snippet to paste into the invite (copyable):
```
6:30pm PT — Weekly Evening Triage (30m)
- 00-10m: Backlog scrub (assign owners)
- 10-20m: Bug queue deep-dive (top 5)
- 20-25m: Owner handoffs & action items
- 25-30m: Quick blockers / follow-ups
```
Devon Park: Small request — add a "service impact" column to the rota so oncall knows who to ping for high-impact issues.
Samir Patel: Will add that column and wire it into the calendar notes + triage-bot notifications. Volunteers for week 1: Devon, Lina, Maria?
Lina Chen: I can take week 1. :thumbsup:
Alex Lee: Thanks everyone. If no objections by EOD I'll update the calendar, create the 3-week pilot series, and add triage-bot reminders.
Maria Gonzalez: Sounds good to me.
Devon Park: Good plan.
triage-bot: ACTION: will send a follow-up reminder 24h before the first evening triage once calendar invite is created.
